items.title: 18.7.2 Cobalt(II) complexes ke ligand exchange reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.7.2 with Figures 18.9 and 18.10, printed pages 25-26.

blocks.text: Cobalt(II) salts bhi paani mein complex ions banate hain. Copper(II) ki tarah Co²⁺(aq) se murad complex ion [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ hai, jo cobalt(II) sulphate ke solution ko gulabi (pink) rang deta hai. Sodium hydroxide solution dalne par cobalt(II) hydroxide ka neela precipitate banta hai, jo kuch der para rahe to gulabi ho sakta hai.

Cobalt(II) hydroxide ke precipitate mein zyada (excess) ammonia solution dalne se ligand exchange hota hai: ammonia ligands paani aur hydroxide ligands ki jagah le kar ghulne wala ammine complex, hexaamminecobalt(II) ion, banate hain. Solution ka rang peela (yellow) ho jata hai (Figure 18.9).

blocks.alt: Baen se daen chaar test tubes: [Co(H2O)6]2+ ka gulabi mehlool; NaOH solution ke baad [Co(H2O)4(OH)2] ka neela precipitate; pare rehne par gulabi precipitate; zaid ammonia se [Co(NH3)6]2+ ka peela-bhoora mehlool.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.9: Hydroxide aur NH₃ dalne par [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ mein rang ki tabdeeliyan (kitab ki Figure 18.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure aakhri formula [Co(NH₃)₆]² chhaapti hai; charge 2+ hai, is liye khaake mein [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺ likha hai. Pehle OH⁻ do H₂O ki jagah le kar neela cobalt(II) hydroxide banate hain jo para rehne par gulabi ho sakta hai. Zyada ammonia mein chhe NH₃ sab ligands ki jagah le kar ghulne wala peela hexaamminecobalt(II) ion banate hain.
Concentrated ammonia solution dalne se [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ ke paani ke ligands seedhe ammonia ligands se bhi badle ja sakte hain.
Cobalt(II) ions ke solution mein concentrated hydrochloric acid qatra qatra dalne se neela solution banta hai jis mein tetrahedral complex [CoCl₄]²⁻(aq) hota hai (Figure 18.10).

blocks.alt: Do test tubes: [Co(H2O)6]2+ ka gulabi mehlool conc. HCl daalne se [CoCl4]2- ka neela mehlool ban jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.10: Co(II) complex mein paani ke molecules ki jagah chloride ions (kitab ki Figure 18.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaar Cl⁻ chhe H₂O ki jagah lete hain. Gulabi [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ octahedral (6 ligands) hai aur neela [CoCl₄]²⁻ tetrahedral (4 ligands); shakal aur ligand badalne se ΔE badalta hai aur rang gulabi se neela ho jata hai. Paani dalne se yeh tabdeeli wapas ho jati hai.
Paani wale cobalt(II) ions aam tor par monodentate anionic ligands, jaise Cl⁻, OH⁻ aur SCN⁻, ke saath tetrahedral complexes banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Cobalt(II) solution mein conc. HCl dalne par rang kaise badalta hai aur kaun sa ion banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gulabi se neela, kyun ke tetrahedral [CoCl₄]²⁻ banta hai.

items: Zyada NH₃ se peela [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺; conc. HCl se neela [CoCl₄]²⁻.
